about_blocks.text: The Southern Alcare Manor is a long-term residential program. The entire program lasts 90 days total. There is a possibility to go one more year to the 4th stage house after the completion of the 90 days program.The facility has 25 beds and so can have that many people following the program at the same time. The program includes mandatory NA or AA meetings. And there are also life skill counselling and information sessions so that the addicts can get educated on how life works and how addiction comes about. They will also be helped in getting a job and /or a position in a school to get some more education. This is all done so that the person can truly get over the addiction and get their lives back.
